name: לוּדִי
summary: The Ludim, a people descended from Mizraim, listed in both genealogies immediately before the Anamim. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: לוּדִים is the first plural object of יָלַד after the subject מִצְרַיִם.
The genealogy again names the Ludim and then the Anamim among Mizraim’s descendants.

note: Moved from the former word entry `lwwdiy` (old root key לוד). TIPNR’s Lud@Gen.10.22, Shem’s son (names/lwwd), also carries לוּדִי forms (Lydians); the noun entry cited only Mizraim’s Ludim, so only Ludim@Gen.10.13 is named.
